description: Experimental data on filling and emptying of a large-scale pipeline is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xifeng Chen et al. Laboratory-scale experiments are one of the most important means to explore the evolution of air-water interfaces and the mechanisms of pressure oscillations in pipelines during rapid filling and emptying processes. This study presents a dataset obtained from the experimental results of the flow behaviours during the pressure-gradient-driven filling and emptying processes of a large-scale pipeline. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2024. Formats: CSV, Excel, TXT, PDF. The data are held in Science Data Bank and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 18264772800 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
